contentHtml:
Interior design for a ready-to-move flat on Sohna Road typically costs between ₹15 lakh and ₹35 lakh for a full 3BHK or 4BHK, and takes 75-110 days from design freeze to handover — longer than a bare-shell apartment because most Sohna Road societies are 8-15 years old and need electrical, plumbing, and civil rework hidden behind the existing finishes before any new design can go in.

That single fact changes how homeowners on this corridor should budget and plan, and it's the reason a generic "interior design cost Gurgaon" guide doesn't serve Sohna Road buyers well. This guide breaks down what actually drives cost and time here, room by room and society-age by society-age.

Why Sohna Road Is a Different Interior Design Brief Than New Gurgaon or Dwarka Expressway

Sohna Road (Sector 26 through Sector 49, running from MG Road down to Rajiv Chowk and beyond) was one of Gurgaon's earlier growth corridors. Large private developments here — societies in the Malibu Towne, Central Park, Vatika India Next, Ansal Esencia, and BPTP Park Serene mould — were largely built and handed over through the mid-2000s to mid-2010s. That makes the corridor's housing stock meaningfully older, on average, than newer belts like Dwarka Expressway or New Gurgaon's Sector 76-95, where towers are still being delivered bare-shell today.

For a homeowner, this has three practical consequences:

  • You are rarely starting from a bare shell. Most Sohna Road resales and even some "ready" listings come with a previous owner's kitchen, wardrobes, false ceiling, and electrical layout already in place — all of which usually need to be assessed, and often removed, before new design work begins.
  • Wiring and plumbing need a health check, not just a cosmetic update. A flat handed over 10-15 years ago was wired to the electrical load standards of that time — rarely enough for today's ACs in every room, modular kitchen appliances, and home automation.
  • Society rules add a scheduling variable new-construction buyers don't face. Established Sohna Road societies typically have resident welfare associations (RWAs) with defined renovation hours, material-movement rules, and no-objection certificate (NOC) requirements — all of which need to be factored into your timeline before work starts, not after.

2026 Interior Design Cost Ranges for Sohna Road Homes

These are realistic, full-scope turnkey ranges for Sohna Road flats — covering civil work, electrical rework, false ceiling, modular kitchen, wardrobes, and soft furnishing, based on The Omega Group's project experience across comparable Gurgaon societies. Actual figures depend on carpet area, material grade, and how much of the existing interior needs to be stripped out first. For a broader breakdown of what drives cost across Gurgaon generally, see our interior design cost guide.

Add 10-15% to the lower end of each range if your flat needs full electrical rewiring or if the existing false ceiling and POP work has to be removed rather than built over — both common in societies over 10 years old.

The Sohna Road Renovation Timeline: What Actually Happens Week by Week

A realistic 3BHK turnkey timeline on this corridor looks like this:

  • Weeks 1-2 — Site assessment & design freeze: Site visit, measurement, checking the existing electrical panel load and plumbing lines, and finalising the 3D design and material palette.
  • Weeks 3-4 — RWA approvals & demolition: Society NOC, lift/material-movement booking, and safe removal of existing kitchen, wardrobes, and false ceiling where needed.
  • Weeks 5-9 — Civil, electrical & plumbing rework: Rewiring, waterproofing checks (especially bathrooms and balconies), and any layout changes.
  • Weeks 10-13 — Carpentry, kitchen & false ceiling install: Modular kitchen, wardrobes, false ceiling, and built-in furniture.
  • Weeks 14-16 — Finishing, snagging & handover: Painting, polishing, deep cleaning, documented quality walkthrough, handover with written snag-fix commitment.

Three Sohna Road-Specific Planning Mistakes to Avoid

1. Skipping an electrical load audit before finalising the kitchen and AC plan. Many older Sohna Road flats were wired for a single AC point per room and a modest kitchen load. If your brief includes a chimney, hob, microwave, dishwasher, and multiple ACs, audit the electrical system at the design stage, not after installation.

2. Assuming your society's renovation window matches a new-construction project's. Established RWAs typically restrict heavy work to specific daytime hours and may require a refundable security deposit. Build this into your project calendar.

3. Not budgeting for hidden civil work. Waterproofing failures, old plumbing lines, and uneven flooring are common discoveries once old finishes come off. A turnkey partner who inspects before quoting protects you from mid-project cost surprises.

Why a Turnkey Approach Works Best for Sohna Road's Older Housing Stock

Because a Sohna Road renovation typically touches civil, electrical, and plumbing work as well as design and carpentry, coordinating separate contractors for each trade is where most delays and cost overruns happen. The Omega Group's turnkey model — one team accountable from concept through 3D visualisation, material selection, site supervision, and delivery — is built specifically for this kind of layered renovation. With 10+ years of experience, 90+ completed projects across Gurgaon and NCR, a 90% on-time delivery record, and 70+ quality checks per project, homeowners get a single point of accountability instead of managing electricians, plumbers, and carpenters separately.

faqs.question: How much does interior design cost for a 3BHK on Sohna Road in 2026?
faqs.answer: A full turnkey interior for a 3BHK on Sohna Road (1,450-1,900 sq ft carpet area) typically costs ₹18-30 lakh in 2026, covering civil and electrical rework, modular kitchen, wardrobes, false ceiling, and soft furnishing.

faqs.question: Why does interior design take longer in Sohna Road societies than in new Gurgaon projects?
faqs.answer: Most Sohna Road societies were built and handed over between the mid-2000s and mid-2010s, so flats usually already have an existing kitchen, wardrobes, and electrical layout that need assessment and often removal before new design work can begin.

faqs.question: Do I need my RWA's approval before starting interior work on Sohna Road?
faqs.answer: Yes. Established Sohna Road societies have RWAs that typically require an NOC, define permitted renovation hours, and may ask for a refundable security deposit before work begins.

faqs.question: Should I rewire an older Sohna Road flat before installing a modular kitchen?
faqs.answer: If your kitchen plan includes multiple high-load appliances and your flat is more than 8-10 years old, an electrical load audit before installation is strongly recommended.

faqs.question: What is the typical timeline for a full home interior on Sohna Road?
faqs.answer: 75-100 days from design freeze to handover for a 3BHK, and 90-120 days for a 4BHK or independent floor.
